name: SH2 Cast - Dual (self)
description: MSCO's Dual Cast Self Variation 2 art on the neutral MSCO_left1-4 path names, for a fire-and-forget SELF cast resolved to DUAL. SpellHotbar_SpellAnimationType (0x815) == 10017 is kSelf.variant; no casting-source condition, per the dual convention. MSCO ships three self-dual clips, so slot 4 wraps back to the first. The clips keep MSCO's MLh_SpellFire_Event; a dual cast arms both hands, so either commits.
